  absolute metric values (compare before/after, or skip).

  defined or imported, and do not redefine `newServer` or other names that main.go/metrics.go declare.
prompt:
Implement this service.

<spec>
name: feature-flag-service
description: Stores feature flags with percentage rollout and evaluates them per user.
endpoints:
- method: GET
  path: /health
- method: GET
  path: /metrics
- method: PUT
  path: /flags/{name}
  description: 'body {enabled: bool, rollout_percent: int 0..100}; 200 or 201; 400
    if rollout_percent out of range, enabled missing, or malformed JSON'
- method: GET
  path: /flags/{name}
  description: 200 the flag; 404 if unknown
- method: GET
  path: /flags
  description: 200 JSON list of all flags
- method: GET
  path: /evaluate
  description: 'query params flag and user (both required, else 400). 404 if flag
    unknown. 200 {enabled: bool}: false if the flag is disabled, else true iff fnv32a(user)
    % 100 < rollout_percent'
metrics:
- name: flags_total
  type: gauge
  help: Number of flags defined
- name: flag_evaluations_total
  type: counter
  help: Successful evaluations
behaviors:
- 'Evaluation is deterministic: the same user always gets the same answer for the
  same flag'
probes:
- method: PUT
  path: /flags/beta
  expect_status:
  - 200
  - 201
  body: '{"enabled": true, "rollout_percent": 100}'
- method: PUT
  path: /flags/bad
  expect_status:
  - 400
  body: '{"enabled": true, "rollout_percent": 150}'
- method: GET
  path: /flags/beta
  expect_status:
  - 200
- method: GET
  path: /evaluate?flag=beta&user=u1
  expect_status:
  - 200
- method: GET
  path: /evaluate?flag=nope&user=u1
  expect_status:
  - 404
- method: GET
  path: /evaluate?flag=beta
  expect_status:
  - 400
</spec>

Already provided by templates (do NOT write or register these):
- main.go: `func newServer() http.Handler` serves GET /health and GET /metrics, then calls
  `registerRoutes(mux)`. Do not register /health or /metrics yourself.
- metrics.go: Prometheus variables you must keep up to date from your handlers:
- flagsTotal  (gauge) -> exposed as `flags_total`; use Set/Inc/Dec/Add
- flagEvaluationsTotal  (counter) -> exposed as `flag_evaluations_total`; use Inc/Add

You must write these files:
1. handlers.go - defines `func registerRoutes(mux *http.ServeMux)` that registers ONLY these routes:
   - PUT /flags/{name}  body {enabled: bool, rollout_percent: int 0..100}; 200 or 201; 400 if rollout_percent out of range, enabled missing, or malformed JSON
   - GET /flags/{name}  200 the flag; 404 if unknown
   - GET /flags  200 JSON list of all flags
   - GET /evaluate  query params flag and user (both required, else 400). 404 if flag unknown. 200 {enabled: bool}: false if the flag is disabled, else true iff fnv32a(user) % 100 < rollout_percent
   Keep state in memory (you may add store.go). Return JSON with proper status codes; reject
   malformed input with 400. The behaviors in the spec are verified at runtime.
2. handlers_test.go - at least 3 `func TestXxx(t *testing.T)` functions using
   net/http/httptest against `newServer()`. Never bind real ports; tests must finish in seconds.
3. README.md - must contain: an "## Endpoints" section listing EVERY spec endpoint (including
   /health and /metrics) as `METHOD /path` in backticks, and a "## Metrics" section listing EVERY
   metric name in backticks. Only document things that actually exist.
